investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Coralis Education (online learning); Platform: AWS us-east-2 (zones us-east-2a/us-east-2b/us-east-2c); network range 10.150.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster corali-prod-useast (EKS); Database: postgres server forum-db-01 reachable from the application network only through security group sg-85dfc88951ed0396f; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
